title: Lodge an annual summary of financial affairs: Tier 1 and 2 associations
summary: This page explains the process and requirements for Tier 1 and Tier 2 associations to lodge an annual summary of their financial affairs.
intro:
Tier 1 (large) and Tier 2 (small) associations are required to lodge an annual summary of their financial affairs at the earlier date of either:

Late fees apply if you lodge your annual summary more than one month after the AGM.

### Definitions

Tier 1 and Tier 2 associations are defined by the gross receipts or total revenue (income or money collected) and current assets (cash, bank accounts or shares) held in the association’s financial year.

faqs.q: When must an annual summary of financial affairs be lodged?
faqs.a: The annual summary must be lodged by the earlier date of either the AGM or one month after the AGM. Late fees apply if lodged more than one month after the AGM.

faqs.q: How are Tier 1 and Tier 2 associations defined?
faqs.a: Associations are defined by their gross receipts or total revenue and current assets held during the financial year.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to lodge the annual summary?
faqs.a: Any representative of an association authorized by the committee is eligible to lodge the annual summary.
